items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: T-Bone Walker used to go out there in fact, he was working out there, and I always liked the way he'd sing the blues.

ctx.x: You were telling me about (inaudible) Some experiences that you had musically here in Los Angeles.

Yeah, this was way back when I was with Lunceford, and there was open way out by, out that way, called Honey's, and There wasn't nothing but open fields out there at that time. But T-Bone Walker used to go out there in fact, he was working out there, and I always liked the way he'd sing the blues. But you no longer (inaudible). So we used to go out there -Willie Smith, myself, Joe Thomas- after we got through work, but out there -- there would be a lot of musicians sittin' around, jamming. (inaudible) already out…
I remember one night out there Ben Webster was up there (inaudible).
